answer: For a poll on storing a seed kernel in a timber shelter in the grove, each key must lock a distinct $10 bond for 30 days. The server checks election-bound bonds and signatures, counting one ballot per key and rejecting invalid or reused bonds. Anyone may submit two conflicting election-bound signatures from a key; the contract verifies them and forfeits its bond, rejecting invalid proofs. Extra keys tie up $10 each. One person can fund many keys, and consistent sybils lose no bond.
